verdict.rationale: Mercury's invoicing docs explicitly support recurring invoices at a chosen frequency, and invoicing data flows into Books. The pack has no evidence of automatic payment reminders for overdue customers, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: automatic overdue payment reminders, documentation of recurring-invoice configuration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set up recurring invoices and automatic payment reminders for overdue customers

citations.quote: Sending the same invoices repeatedly? Make it recurring in a few clicks and at your chosen frequency.
Create, send, and track invoices programmatically
All your transactions across banking, invoicing, bill pay, and more are pulled in automatically
